rule: A candidate is a pull request of a development repository group of the AACR split, from one of the group's AACR repositories under the name GitHub now answers with, merged into the default branch between 2026-01-01 and 2026-03-31, that: is not authored by a bot; changes as many lines (additions plus deletions) as AACR's usable cases, from the fewest to the most; has a review by someone other than its author and no review that requested changes; and within 90 days of its merge, read after those days had passed, has no later commit or linking issue or pull request that names it as a fix, revert or follow-up on the line that names it (its quoted title aside) or is labelled as a bug, no file of it renamed, and no later commit on the default branch, whatever its message says, that changes, removes or inserts next to a line it added or a place it removed lines. Its lines are placed in each such commit's parent by a diff of the file at its head and at that parent; a line that cannot be followed (unless the parent does not hold its merge at all) and a commit too large to read exclude it. Each group's merged pull requests (GitHub's search, the 100 opened last) are taken in the order of sha256(salt, NUL, group, NUL, repository#number) until 2 are listed or 12 checked. A candidate is not a case: it enters suites/clean/cases.json only through a person's clean ruling (queue.mjs decide, on the sheet that shows the current candidates) and clean.mjs admit, which refuses a ruling whose sheet or evidence moved.
